title: High-Precision Skin Disease Diagnosis through Deep Learning on Dermoscopic Images.
summary: A CNN classified three dermoscopic skin-disease labels on held-out ISIC images with 87.64% test accuracy. This is dataset-based diagnostic validation only; the authors call for real-world clinical evaluation.
